chunks.arabic_text: وَ رَوَى زُرَارَةُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ

translations.en: Zurarah narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he said:

chunks.arabic_text: «اَلَّذِي يَخَافُ اللُّصُوصَ وَ السَّبُعَ يُصَلِّي صَلَاةَ الْمُوَاقَفَةِ إِيمَاءً عَلَى دَابَّتِهِ»

translations.en: "One who fears robbers or a wild beast performs the prayer of al-muwāqafah by gesture upon his mount."

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ قُلْتُ أَ رَأَيْتَ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنِ الْمُوَاقِفُ عَلَى وُضُوءٍ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ وَ لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَى النُّزُولِ

translations.en: He said: I said, "What do you think—if the one կանգed in such a situation is not in a state of wudu (ablution), how should he act, while he is unable to dismount?"

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ «يَتَيَمَّمُ مِنْ لِبْدِ دَابَّتِهِ أَوْ سَرْجِهِ أَوْ مَعْرَفَةِ دَابَّتِهِ فَإِنَّ فِيهَا غُبَارًا وَ يُصَلِّي وَ يَجْعَلُ السُّجُودَ أَخْفَضَ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ وَ لَا يَدُورُ إِلَى الْقِبْلَةِ وَ لَكِنْ أَيْنَمَا دَارَتْ دَابَّتُهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ يَسْتَقْبِلُ الْقِبْلَةَ بِأَوَّلِ تَكْبِيرَةٍ حِينَ يَتَوَجَّهُ.

translations.en: He said: "He performs tayammum from the felt of his mount, or its saddle, or the mane of his mount, for indeed there is dust in it; and he prays, making the sajdah lower than the rukūʿ. He does not turn toward the qiblah, but rather wherever his mount turns—except that he faces the qiblah with the first takbīrah when he begins."

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for salat in a state of fear when a person cannot safely dismount from their mount because of robbers or wild beasts. It also explains how tayammum may be done from dust found on riding equipment and that the person begins by facing the qiblah at the opening takbir, then continues praying according to necessity.
en.seo_question: How should someone perform salat and tayammum on a mount when fearing danger and unable to dismount?

key_terms.اللُّصُوصَ: robbers or bandits who create a state of danger
key_terms.صَلَاةَ الْمُوَاقَفَةِ: the prayer performed in a dangerous halted or constrained situation
key_terms.إِيمَاءً: by gesture, rather than full bodily movements
key_terms.وُضُوءٍ: wudu (ablution), the state of ritual purity for salat
key_terms.الْقِبْلَةَ: the direction of prayer toward which one faces
